verdict.rationale: OpenCode's own llms.txt file returns 404, so there is no dedicated llms.txt for agents, but probes show that docs pages are available in machine-readable Markdown form (.md suffix returns 200), which serves an analogous agent-oriented documentation function. There's no first-party statement about llms.txt support or explicit agent-doc pointing workflow. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt endpoint, documentation instructing users to point agents at machine-readable docs, and confirmation that agents can consume the .md docs as intended.
